name: Espresso
description: A strong and bold coffee shot made by forcing hot water through finely ground coffee beans.

name: Americano
description: Espresso diluted with hot water for a smooth and rich coffee experience.

name: Cappuccino
description: Espresso with steamed milk and a thick layer of foam to create a creamy texture.

name: Mocha
